hero.title: How AgriNova Works
hero.subtitle: From farm to market, AgriNova creates a simple and transparent way for farmers and buyers to connect directly.

farmerSteps.title: Create Your Farmer Account
farmerSteps.description: Sign up with your mobile number and verified email OTP. Set up your digital farming identity in minutes.

farmerSteps.title: Add Farm Information
farmerSteps.description: Specify your farm location, land area, primary crops, and harvest cycles for accurate buyer matching.

farmerSteps.title: List Your Produce
farmerSteps.description: Publish available produce specifying crop variety, quantity, quality grade, expected price, and dispatch dates.

farmerSteps.title: Receive Buyer Interest
farmerSteps.description: Get direct trade inquiries, bids, and purchase offers from verified merchants and institutional bulk buyers.

farmerSteps.title: Connect & Negotiate
farmerSteps.description: Communicate directly with interested buyers to discuss delivery terms, logistics, and fair market pricing.

farmerSteps.title: Finalize Trade & Deliver
farmerSteps.description: Confirm the order agreement, schedule farm pickup or mandi delivery, and settle transactions transparently.

buyerSteps.title: Register as Buyer
buyerSteps.description: Complete business registration with company information, verified email OTP, and optional GSTIN credentials.

buyerSteps.title: Complete Business Profile
buyerSteps.description: Select your trade category—wholesaler, food processor, exporter, retailer, or institutional purchaser.

buyerSteps.title: Browse Agricultural Marketplace
buyerSteps.description: Explore available fresh harvest listings directly from registered Indian farmers across nearby states and regions.

buyerSteps.title: Search & Filter Produce
buyerSteps.description: Filter by crop type, regional mandi benchmarks, lot volume, harvest freshness, and verified farmer badges.

buyerSteps.title: Connect with Farmer
buyerSteps.description: Initiate direct trade discussions without middlemen or commission agent markups.

buyerSteps.title: Negotiate and Purchase
buyerSteps.description: Agree on terms, finalize lot quantity and logistics, and build long-term farm-to-business sourcing relationships.

cta.title: Start Sourcing or Selling Today
cta.subtitle: Join India's modern agricultural trading network and unlock direct market connections.
